name: Deposits & Partial Payments for WooCommerce – Deposet
author: Apselo

sections.description:
Deposet is an all in one WooCommerce deposits and partial payments plugin. Let customers pay a deposit, put down a down payment, or pay in installments now and pay the remaining balance later. It is the easy way to add deposits, partial payments, payment plans, and pay later options to any WooCommerce store.

Whether you sell high value products, take bookings and appointments, run pre-orders, or offer made to order and custom items, Deposet helps you capture more sales by letting shoppers split the cost. Instead of paying the full price up front, customers can pay a partial payment today and settle the balance over time.

Deposet works with both the classic cart and checkout and the new WooCommerce block (Gutenberg) cart and checkout, so your deposit and installment options show up correctly no matter which checkout your theme uses.

Why choose Deposet

  • Accept WooCommerce deposits as a percentage or a fixed amount.
  • Offer partial payments and pay later without a third party finance provider.
  • Let customers pay in installments (for example 3 months or 6 months) with a custom payment schedule.
  • Manage everything from one simple Deposit Rules screen.
  • Full support for the block based checkout and the classic checkout.
  • No coding required.

Key features

  • Deposit Rules engine – Manage all deposits, partial payments, and payment plans from one place. Set a type, a rule, and which products it applies to.
  • Percentage or fixed deposits – Charge a percentage deposit (for example 30 percent) or a fixed amount down payment on any product.
  • Installment payment plans – Build custom installment plans with multiple payments. Set how much is due today and split the remaining balance over days, weeks, or months.
  • Multiple plans per product – Offer more than one option on the same product, for example a 3 month plan and a 6 month plan, and let the customer choose.
  • Flexible scope – Apply a deposit rule to all products, to specific categories, or to specific products, with exclude lists and priority for fine control.
  • Store wide default deposit – Set one default deposit that applies across your whole store.
  • Deposit display location – Show the deposit option on the product page, on the checkout page, or on both.
  • Force deposit – Require a deposit and hide the full payment option when you want to guarantee a partial payment.
  • Default selection – Pre select deposit or full payment for the customer.
  • Block cart and checkout support – Deposit and installment options work in the WooCommerce block (Gutenberg) cart and checkout using the Store API, plus the classic cart and checkout.
  • Per item deposit breakdown – Customers see due today, remaining balance, and installment details right in the cart and checkout.
  • Partial payment orders – Each installment and remaining balance is tracked as its own payable order, so customers can pay online any time.
  • Automated emails – Deposit confirmation, payment reminder, and final payment emails. Fully editable from WooCommerce email settings.
  • Payment reminders – Automatic reminder emails for upcoming and overdue installments and remaining balances.
  • My Account integration – Customers view their payment schedule and due dates and pay the remaining balance or installments from their account.
  • User role restrictions – Disable deposits for specific user roles.
  • Login requirement – Optionally require customers to log in to use deposits.
  • Stock control – Choose whether stock is reduced on the deposit payment or on the full payment.
  • Payment gateway control – Disable specific payment gateways for deposit orders.
  • Refund support – Handle refunds for deposit and partial payment orders.
  • Translation ready – Built with standard WordPress internationalization.

Perfect for

  • High ticket and high value products such as furniture, electronics, and jewelry
  • Bookings, appointments, rentals, events, and tickets
  • Pre-orders and crowdfunding style campaigns
  • Made to order, custom, and handmade products
  • Courses, memberships, services, travel, and tours
  • Any store that wants a buy now pay later or pay in part option

How it works

  1. Create a Deposit Rule and choose a type: percentage, fixed amount, or installment payment plan.
  2. Choose where it applies: all products, selected categories, or specific products.
  3. Customers choose to pay a deposit, pick a payment plan, or pay the full amount.
  4. The deposit or first installment is charged at checkout.
  5. The remaining balance and installment due dates are tracked automatically.
  6. Customers pay the balance or installments from the My Account page, and Deposet sends automatic reminder emails.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/deposet/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Deposet then Settings to enable deposits and configure general options.
  4. Go to Deposet then Rules to create your first deposit rule or installment payment plan.
  5. Open a product and test the checkout with a deposit or installment plan.

Deposet requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.
sections.faq:
Can I accept deposits in WooCommerce?

Yes. Deposet lets you accept deposits on any WooCommerce product. You can charge a percentage deposit or a fixed amount and the customer pays the remaining balance later.

Can customers pay in installments such as 3 months or 6 months?

Yes. You can create installment payment plans with a custom schedule. Set how much is due today and split the rest into multiple payments over days, weeks, or months. You can even offer more than one plan on the same product and let the customer choose.

Does it work with the WooCommerce block cart and checkout?

Yes. Deposet supports both the classic cart and checkout and the new WooCommerce block (Gutenberg) cart and checkout. The deposit option, installment details, and breakdown show in both.

Can I set a deposit as a percentage or a fixed amount?

Yes. Each deposit rule can be a percentage of the price or a fixed amount down payment.

Can I offer more than one payment plan on the same product?

Yes. If more than one rule applies to a product, every matching option is shown so customers can choose the plan that suits them, or pay in full.

Can I require a deposit and disable the full payment option?

Yes. Turn on Force deposit to require a partial payment and hide the pay in full option.

Where do customers pay the remaining balance?

Customers pay the remaining balance and any installments from the My Account area. Each payment is a secure, payable order, and Deposet sends automatic reminder emails before payments are due.

Can I apply deposits only to certain products or categories?

Yes. A deposit rule can target all products, specific categories, or specific products. You can also exclude products and set priority to control which rule wins.

Does Deposet send payment reminder emails?

Yes. Deposet sends deposit confirmation, payment reminder, and final payment emails. You can edit the subject, heading, and content from the WooCommerce email settings.

Is Deposet free?

Yes. Deposet is a free WooCommerce deposits and partial payments plugin. Visit apselo.com for documentation and support.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Deposit Rules engine. Manage all deposits, partial payments, and payment plans from one screen, with rules scoped to all products, specific categories, or specific products.
  • New: Installment payment plans with a custom payment schedule. Set the amount due today and split the balance over days, weeks, or months.
  • New: Multiple deposit options per product. Offer more than one plan, for example a 3 month plan and a 6 month plan, and let the customer choose.
  • New: WooCommerce block (Gutenberg) cart and checkout support through the Store API, alongside the classic cart and checkout.
  • New: Deposit display location setting. Show the store wide default deposit on the product page, the checkout page, or both.
  • New: Per item deposit and installment breakdown in the cart and checkout, including due today and remaining balance.
  • Tweak: Renamed Plans to Deposit Rules across the admin for clarity.
  • Fix: Duplicate deposit confirmation and payment reminder emails caused by email classes being registered twice.
  • Fix: Product level deposits now correctly charge the reduced deposit amount at checkout.

1.0.2

  • Tweak: WordPress 6.9 compatibility.

1.0.1

  • New: deposit option for the checkout page.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
